summary: Two 1942 and 1950 newspaper clippings on a lookout history site place a fire tower at Wetappo in Gulf County. No build or current-condition source found.

events.note: One of four aircraft spotting stations in Gulf County was located at the fire tower at Wetappo; the stations reported daily to a district control center at Thomasville, Georgia.
Fire protection methods and equipment were demonstrated to Port St. Joe 4-H club boys at the Wetappo fire tower.

evidence.supports: four aircraft spotting stations in the county; one at the fire tower at Wetappo
evidence.quote: Four aircraft spotting stations are now functioning in the county. One being located at the fire tower at Wetappo.

evidence.supports: the stations reported daily to the district control center at Thomasville, Georgia
evidence.quote: These stations are now reporting daily to the district control center at Thomasville, Ga.

evidence.supports: the aircraft-stations clipping is dated April 3, 1942 (The Star)
1950 demonstration of fire protection methods at the Wetappo tower for Port St. Joe 4-H boys
evidence.quote: Fire protection methods and equipment were demonstrated to the Port St. Joe 4-H club boys at Wetappo fire tower here recently

evidence.supports: the 1950 item ran in the Panama City News Herald
two of the boys were so interested that they made a forest land ownership map of Gulf County for the county agent
evidence.quote: Two of the boys were so interested they made a colored forest land ownership map of Gulf county for the county agent's office

evidence.supports: the page places Wetappo in Gulf County

sources.title: Wetappo, FOREST LOOKOUTS (clippings from The Star, April 3, 1942, and Panama City News Herald, May 7, 1950)

notes_for_editor: Thin: two clippings on one hobby-site page (originals not checked). Lead only, not used: a search result for an anyplaceamerica.com topo page gives the alternate name Wetappo Forest Ranger Station; that page was not read. Cached NHLR and FFLOS pages do not mention Wetappo. Consider other_names if a source confirms the alternate name. Build date, staffing after 1950, agency and current condition remain unsourced.
